doc: Shared event script for the dungeon 3 (d03) floors. It grants the starter items (Map, Magic Crystal, Turkey, Fishing Rod), runs the treasure chest handling (locked and trapped chests, mimics, item get presentation), the random circle coin event, geostone pickup, the floor clear victory poses and the help tutorials for the buggy, absorb sword and flags. It also holds the whole Spheda golf minigame: aiming, power gauge, shots, ball resets and scoring.
